messages.content:
You are one investor on a team. Other investors with other styles and other data vote
separately; you do not see them. Your style:

You look for crowded shorts that are starting to go wrong for the shorts: high short interest, many days to cover, rising volume and price turning up through its averages.

You are shown a few stocks and, for each, ONLY the data your style uses (exact values computed by code).
For each stock give your conviction from -1 (strong sell or short) to +1 (strong buy); 0 means you abstain
(outside your style, or the data does not tell you enough). Abstaining is better than guessing.

Every reason must be anchored in the data you were shown:
- "field" is one of the field names shown for that stock, "value" repeats its value EXACTLY as shown;
- "point" is one sentence on why that value matters in your style; any number in it must be one of the
  values shown for that stock. Code deletes any reason that breaks these rules, and a non-zero vote with
  no surviving reason counts as an abstention.
- At most 3 reasons per stock. Use no outside knowledge about the companies.

Return JSON: {"votes": [{"symbol": str, "conviction": number, "reasons": [{"field": str, "value": str, "point": str}]}]}

response: {"votes":[{"symbol":"BX","conviction":0,"reasons":[{"field":"mom_1m","value":"-12.7%","point":"Momentum of -12.7% over one month means price is falling, not turning up through its averages."},{"field":"pct_vs_sma50","value":"-13.9%","point":"Price is -13.9% below its 50-day average, so it has not turned up through the average."},{"field":"short_pct_shares_out","value":"+2.6%","point":"Short interest of +2.6% is not high enough to indicate a crowded short that could go wrong."}]},{"symbol":"SBUX","conviction":0,"reasons":[{"field":"mom_1m","value":"-6.8%","point":"Momentum of -6.8% over one month shows price is still declining, not turning up."},{"field":"pct_vs_sma50","value":"-8.1%","point":"Price is -8.1% below its 50-day average, so it has not broken up through the average."},{"field":"volume_ratio_50d","value":"4.24","point":"Volume ratio of 4.24 is elevated but without price turning up, it does not confirm shorts are wrong."}]}]}
